instruction: A clean studio photograph, full-body wide shot. In an indoor dance studio with a beige backdrop and white wall, three women are dancing in a synchronized line. On the left, the dark-haired woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) crouches low with knees bent, looking forward. In the center foreground, the brown-haired woman in the white crop top and black jeans (R1) leans forward with her right leg extended, head tilted back with an expressive open-mouthed face. On the right, the blonde woman in the white crop top and dark blue jeans (R3) leans forward with legs spread, looking forward. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting with warm beige and white tones.
